tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on Light And Optics

questions.question: Higher Light enters water from air at an angle of incidence of 35 degrees. The angle of refraction is 26 degrees. Calculate the refractive index of water.
questions.explanation: Answer: Q3: n = sin i / sin r = sin(35) / sin(26) = 0.574 / 0.438 = 1.31

questions.question: Higher Diamond has a refractive index of 2.42. Calculate its critical angle.
questions.explanation: Answer: Q4: sin C = 1 / n = 1 / 2.42 = 0.413. C = sin⁻¹(0.413) = 24.4 degrees

questions.question: Foundation An object 4 cm tall is viewed through a convex lens and produces an image 12 cm tall. Calculate the magnification.
questions.correctAnswer: Q5: Magnification = image height / object height = 12 / 4 = 3
questions.explanation: Answer: Q5: Magnification = image height / object height = 12 / 4 = 3
